race.description: Zeppelin Travel Birdsville Races Charter Hcp (Bm65)
race.comment: VORKUTA (7) continued his honest form with a solid third over 1100m at Ipswich just over 2 weeks ago, and he looks well placed to be in the finish again. ARCHIE MAXIMUS (10) fought bravely when landing a narrow victory at this track 2 starts ago and benefits from another favourable draw. He led up and faded last time out, and he should race with cover this time from the pole position. Stick with him. IMMEDIATE (12) was an impressive all-the-way winner at Ipswich last start, and she has top 4 claims in this. LADY SHOTGUN (4) resumes from a spell at a suitable level, and any market confidence would be worth following. THRASH A BULLY (15) has been holding her form well, and from a good draw, she has top 4 claims again.
